name: Sturzstromer

items.name: Tremorsense (Precise) 120 feet, (Imprecise) 240 feet
items.text:
A sturzstromer's tremorsense is a precise sense out to 120 feet and an imprecise sense out to 240 feet. A sturzstromer can't sense anything beyond the range of its tremorsense.

---

items.name: Clutching Stones
items.text: The sturzstromer's space is greater difficult terrain.

items.name: Grasping Bites
items.text:
The sturzstromer attempts an Athletics check check and compares the result to the Fortitude DC of each creature in its space. This counts as two attacks for the sturzstromer's multiple attack penalty.

---

Critical Success The creature is Grabbed, takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage, and is Restrained until the end of the sturzstromer's next turn.

Success The creature is grabbed.

items.name: Landslide
items.text:
Requirements The sturzstromer's most recent action was to cast Earthquake.

---

Effect The sturzstromer closes a fissure it made, choosing one creature that fell in. That creature must succeed at a DC 41 Reflex save save or be buried as in an avalanche.

items.name: Pummeling Assault
items.text: Each foe in the sturzstromer's space takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage (DC 41 basic Reflex save save).

text:
Cobble mites that remain a cohesive swarm for many years become dangerous living landslides.

---

Cobble mites resemble squarish stones a few inches across with mouths like split geodes. Though indolent and harmless alone, they're dangerous in large groups.
